scope: Linux copy publication retries after final directory permissions deny ordinary read-open

Reopening uses the pinned inode; the held and named versions are checked before finalization and after directory barriers
Interruption after permission preparation leaves a recognized staged version and retained original
Full endpoint position is revalidated before publication rename/finalization
